text:
maya: Heads-up — we started seeing ~1.8% accuracy regression on the structured QA eval after the AWQ group_size change to 96 with act-quant enabled on the red-psi-13b-awq prod variant. Perf looked fine but outputs are hallucinating on tabular QA. https://redwood.internal/obs/awq/overview

sam: Which rollout did we push? can you paste the deploy id and quick numbers? also did latency move?

maya: rollout id: canary-2026-03-awq-96-act. p95 latency +12ms, QA error rate +3.5%, perplexity on eval bench +4.2. Last good rollback at commit abc123. Samples below.

deploy-bot: Deployment canary-2026-03-awq-96-act started 2026-03-20T09:12Z on pool-prod-us-west (10% traffic).

anika: @maya can you dump a few failing samples? are these prompts >512 tokens? act-quant is sensitive to sequence length and activation distributions.

maya: pasted 3 samples into thread (they're short, <200 tokens) — all short QA prompts but answers go off-topic / invent values. Not seeing length dependence. Also this only spikes during continuous-batching bursts.

leo: ran a quick local reproducer on staging. Turning act_quant off immediately fixes the delta vs fp32 reference. Quick notes:

```
# awq config
group_size: 96
act_quant: true
seed: 42

# quick result
rouge-L delta: -1.8
```

sam: try stepping group_size down to 48 or 32 — grouping changes per-channel scaling and can change quant buckets. Also try different seeds.

harper: pushed a minimal canary patch: group_size: 64, act_quant: false for 10% traffic (variant awq-g64-noact). Observability: https://redwood.internal/obs/awq/2738123456

ci-bot: Canary check: variant awq-g64-noact rolled to 10% at 09:40Z. Automated evals (30m): no regression on rouge/acc; p95 latency returned to baseline.

maya: quick repro notes: seed matters. With seed=7 the act-quant variant looks stable; with seed=42 it flips. Suggests randomness in per-group quant scale estimation. :thinking:

leo: hypothesis: activation-scale mismatch for small groups -> stochastic rounding bias across KV blocks. Proposed quick mitigation: deterministic per-layer calibration step before serving (collect a small warmup batch and fix scales). Pseudo:

```
# calibration pseudo
for layer in model.layers:
  scale = median(abs(activations[layer]))
  layer.scale = scale if scale > 1e-6 else 1.0
```

anika: also validate KV-cache alignment — group_size changes can affect padding and how activations are batched, which might interact with act-quant's scaling.

sam: who can run a full sweep (24h-ish) across group_size [32,48,64,96] x act_quant on/off and capture rouge/acc deltas, p95, batcher queue length, and prefix-cache hitrate? I can coordinate infra and traffic routing.

harper: I'll set up the test matrix and queue jobs. Plan: 6-hour buckets per variant, synthetic + live traffic, collect eval snapshots and detailed traces.

maya: thanks — if canary confirms regressions we'll revert the rollout and land the calibration patch. Also add a step in the deploy playbook to check seed stability and a quick smoke that runs `eval-suite --awq-smoke`.

leo: note: we saw a non-deterministic hang once when act_quant + continuous_batching rate >300 req/s. Might be unrelated prealloc bug. Filed ML ticket ML-7823 with trace logs.

maya: ack. I'll add ML-7823 to the rollback checklist. :thumbsup:

sam: good plan. keep updates here and add any independent repro artifacts to the ticket.

harper: kicked off the sweep jobs; will post results into this thread and the ticket.

ci-bot: Job matrix started: 8 variants x 6h each. ETA results ~+48h. Automated alerts wired for >1% rouge drop or >5% QA error increase.

maya: appreciated — leaning toward conservative revert if any variant consistently regresses.

leo: small follow-up: try also toggling continuous_batching=false in a variant to isolate batching vs quant interaction.

anika: noted. adding to matrix.

maya: end of thread for now — will update when canary results land.
